parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json;

// ==================================
// MILA REFERENCE IMAGE
// ==================================

const MILA_REFERENCE_URL =
  "https://res.cloudinary.com/bygikbss/image/upload/f_png/Gemini_Generated_Image_sbqi0fsbqi0fsbqi";

// ==================================
// MILA CHARACTER CONFIGURATION
// ==================================

const character_prompt = `
MAIN CHARACTER: MILA

Mila is a 12-year-old adventurous girl.

APPEARANCE:
- Medium-length wavy chestnut-brown hair
- Large expressive brown eyes
- Teal adventure jacket
- Dark gray cargo pants
- Black adventure boots
- Orange backpack

PERSONALITY:
- Brave
- Curious
- Intelligent
- Kind
- Adventurous
- Expressive
- Sometimes funny

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:

Use the provided Mila reference image
as the primary visual identity.

Preserve her exact:
- Face and facial features
- Eye shape and color
- Hairstyle and hair color
- Clothing and colors
- Body proportions
- Overall character appearance

Mila must look like the same character
in every scene and every episode.

VISUAL STYLE:

High-quality cinematic 3D animation.
Family-friendly science-fiction adventure.
Professional lighting.
Detailed environments.
Natural facial expressions.
Smooth character movements.
Vertical 9:16 composition.

Do not redesign Mila.
`;

// ==================================
// PIP CHARACTER CONFIGURATION
// ==================================

const pip_prompt = `
SECONDARY CHARACTER: PIP

Pip is Mila's loyal robotic companion.

APPEARANCE:
- Small floating robot
- Compact rounded body
- White-and-teal metallic exterior
- Glowing blue expressive eyes
- Soft orange accent lights
- Friendly facial expressions

PERSONALITY:
- Intelligent
- Funny
- Loyal
- Playful
- Supportive
- Slightly nervous sometimes

VOICE:
Friendly and expressive.
Slightly robotic.
Humorous personality.

Maintain the same Pip design
throughout all scenes.
`;

// ==================================
// NEGATIVE PROMPT
// ==================================

const negative_prompt = `
No character redesign.
No different face.
No different hairstyle.
No clothing changes.
No different eye color.
No inconsistent proportions.
No random replacement characters.
No unrelated scenes.
No inconsistent visual style.
No distorted anatomy.
No extra limbs.
No blurry faces.
No duplicated characters.
No flat cartoon style.
No unnecessary visual artifacts.
`;

// ==================================
// VALIDATION
// ==================================

if (
  !Array.isArray(input.scenes) ||
  input.scenes.length === 0
) {
  throw new Error("No episode scenes found.");
}

if (!MILA_REFERENCE_URL.startsWith("https://")) {
  throw new Error("Invalid Mila reference URL.");
}

// ==================================
// FINAL OUTPUT
// ==================================

return [{
  json: {
    ...input,

    reference_images: [
      MILA_REFERENCE_URL
    ],

    reference_ready: true,

    character_prompt,
    pip_prompt,
    negative_prompt,

    scene_count: input.scenes.length,

    total_duration: input.total_duration,

    scenes: input.scenes,

    scene_prompt: input.scene_prompt,

    animation_prompt: input.animation_prompt
  }
}];
